xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-14-51" status="finalized">de la <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8071">rigs pa'i sgo</rs>r <expan>bzhir</expan> che yang 'dir <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3770">kun las btus</rs> <expan>bzhin</expan> du phye na 3 ste ¦ dngos po stobs zhugs <expan>rjes dpag gi</expan> bsal ba'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> ¦ dam bcas pa'i gzhi la dam bca' dang tshad mas gnod pa'i <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="51a2"/> 'gal ba tshul 3 pa'i <expan>rtags</expan> la <expan>brten nas</expan> bsgrub bya dag pa ba rtogs pa'i blos grub ste | dag pa ni sgras khyad par du ma byas pa zhes zer ba <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">chu</rs></note> sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi <expan>rjes dpag</expan>  la ma khyab pa <expan>yin no</expan> || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4006">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4006">ral</rs></note> dam bcas pa gang zhig <expan>rjes dpag gis</expan> gnod pa zhes smra ba ni bsal bya la'ang khyab ches pa <expan>yin no</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
